<div class="wrap" markdown="1">

{% raw %}
In a SWTOR guild you add your own characters, and Alagos signs you up with the right one.

## Add your character

Open `/my-profile`, then the SWTOR tab, then **👤 My characters** and **➕ Add my character**. Give its **name**, its **server**, its **Combat Style** (Sentinel, Marauder, Sorcerer…), and, if you like, its item rating and a logs link. Your first character is your **main**; add alts the same way.

Then open the character and pick your **Discipline** and, if you play one, an **off-Discipline**: the menus show only your style's three. **✏️ Edit** holds a build link or a note for your officers.

## Sign up for an Operation

Press the role you want to play, such as **Healer**. Alagos picks your Discipline for it -- your main, then your off-Discipline, then your style's other one -- on your main character first, then your alts. The post shows you with it, like **Kallig · Corruption Sorcerer**.

In the answer only you see, you can switch Discipline or character. If your role is full you go on its **bench** and move up by yourself; Alagos tells you in a DM.
{% endraw %}
